fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-jsonld) are a near-verbatim spread of the page's NewsArticle JSON-LD block, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-rss) carry title/link-style fields from the section RSS feed.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest:<section>') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (S1-jsonld or S2-rss).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

headline.title: Headline
headline.description: Article headline (raw passthrough from JSON-LD NewsArticle).

description.title: Description
description.description: Short article description/dek (article-mode from JSON-LD, or the RSS item description in latest-mode).

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description: Full article text, when present on the upstream JSON-LD NewsArticle node.

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream JSON-LD (raw passthrough -- may be a dict, list, or string).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream paywall metering flag, when present.

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: dc:creator byline from the RSS item (latest-mode).

section.title: Section (RSS)
section.description: The RSS section/feed name this item was fetched from (latest-mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
